name: AI chatbot specialist
summary: Sets up custom GPTs and support bots with the right knowledge, rules and hand-offs, then tests their answers. Keeps the bot from making things up.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 29 sources covering conversation design, knowledge bases, hand-over to people, testing, AI disclosure (EU AI Act Article 50, UK CMA guidance, US state laws) and data protection; four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
